sources.entry: Scenario GG - AI platform tailored for game developers to create custom assets and environments using generative models.

summary.name: Scenario
summary.one_liner: Scenario is an AI creative production platform for image, video, 3D and audio generation, aimed especially at game asset creation, with workflows, agents and an API.
use_cases: Generate consistent game art and item icon sets
Turn a single image into a textured, riggable 3D model
Create video shots and previs from storyboards
Build reusable generation pipelines shared across a team
Generate textures and props inside Blender
Train a custom model on a studio's own art style
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a browser app where users generate and edit images, create video, turn one image into a textured 3D model, and make sound effects, music and voice, all in one workspace. Users can compare models on the same brief and anchor results with references or trained custom models. A node canvas lets users chain models and tools into workflows, publish them as apps with a form and cost shown before each run, and let a Node Agent build node graphs from a brief. Access is also offered via a Scenario MCP connection for Claude, Codex or Cursor, a REST API with TypeScript and Python SDKs, and a Blender plugin. The page claims access to 750+ models from 50+ providers.
notable: Node-based workflow canvas that can be published as a shared app with a simple form
Scenario MCP and REST API let Claude Code, Codex or Cursor drive the same models and assets
Enterprise tier with IP Detection, SSO, audit log and per-project spend caps
Every generated asset records its model, inputs and prompt
caveats: Pricing shows 50 free daily credits, with paid plans starting at $10/month (Starter); some plan prices are shown as discounted from higher list prices
IP Detection is an optional add-on billed separately in credits
Enterprise plan requires a custom quote and a twelve-month agreement
